text:
ITEM 1 | Large pale golden-brown piece with a crisp, crumbly breaded or crust-like top showing flecks of herbs and browned crumb, flat-sided with a fibrous, layered interior edge; sits upper-left on the plate, roughly 9 x 6 cm, about 1.5 cm thick | 150
ITEM 2 | Tender light-cream piece with a flaky, slightly moist interior, topped with scattered green herb flecks and a golden crumb coating; sits beside item 1 at the top center, roughly 7 x 5 cm, about 1.5 cm thick | 110
ITEM 3 | Dark brown, irregularly shaped pieces with a seared, slightly glossy surface and uneven browned edges, some crispy bits and rough torn texture; sits upper-right, roughly 7 x 5 cm, about 1 cm thick | 90
ITEM 4 | Shredded crisp-looking leafy greens, bright to dark green with pale white-green ribs, coated in a creamy pale dressing with a matte, slightly thick sheen; sits lower-left, roughly 12 x 10 cm, mounded about 2 cm high | 110
ITEM 5 | Creamy pale white dressing clinging to and coating the leafy greens, with some granular bits of cheese or crumbs visible; sits mixed into item 4 | 25
ITEM 6 | Small whole green-brown spheres with a slightly wrinkled, matte surface, some with light browning and a firm, dense texture; cluster sits right of the greens below the meat, roughly 6 cm across in total | 45
ITEM 7 | Pale yellow-green cubed or sliced pieces with a smooth, moist surface and soft texture, sitting among the greens at the lower left edge, roughly 3 x 3 cm each | 20
